spec.name: Blend v32
spec.notes: Multi-factor score: momentum, drift and low risk.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.2, annual return 12%, maximum drawdown 10%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a full sample backtest without any out-of-sample validation, raising concerns about overfitting. The reported Sharpe ratio of 2.2 and annual return of 12% are high, especially given the 10 bps cost. While the research log indicates a best-of trial, the limited number of trials (2) and lack of grid search suggest the result might be lucky. I recommend paper trading to further validate the strategy before deploying real capital.
